\mxunit{enrichment-inequalities-problems}{Inequalities and equality cases}
\mxsubtitle{High school · optimisation and olympiads \textperiodcentered{} Synthesis problem \textperiodcentered{} 11}

\begin{problem}[Investigate, justify, conclude]
There are 40 m of fencing for three sides of a rectangular enclosure against a wall. Its width x, perpendicular to the wall, is positive. Express its length and area in terms of x, determine the domain, then prove the maximum area without derivatives. Compare with a fully fenced rectangle of perimeter 40 m.
\end{problem}
